summary: PASS — zero blocking findings. One non-blocking TODO: the Phase-2 study prompt's line "My Claude Code sessions across every project live under ~/.claude/projects/, one folder per repo I've worked in" is a simplification of check_platform_and_boundaries.md §6e (transcripts are stored one folder per WORKING DIRECTORY, not strictly per repo — a distinction that matters for a student running worktrees, as M6 itself does). Not blocking because the Phase 1 hand-off in this same file correctly avoids the fragile assumption by reading recorded coordinates from task.md/plan.md instead of folder-matching (§31, §6e both PASS); the imprecise phrasing sits only in the unrelated Phase 2 stack-scan prompt, where the approximation is harmless. All sampled Source-verification URLs are alive (3/3); all citations carry honest source-type labels and freshness stamps within window; no zombie stats; no [Skill:]-bracket references to verify; no placeholders inside prompt fences; prompt-chaining mechanics (back-reference to recorded coordinates, warm-session referents, long-run progress-streaming callout, over-reading/premature-stop recovery) all match check_prompts.md's mechanical rules.
